steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Invest in low-carbon transport  
   • Expand and electrify public transit (buses, trams, subways)  
   • Build safe bike lanes and pedestrian zones to reduce car trips  

2. Retrofit and green new buildings  
   • Upgrade insulation, windows, and HVAC systems for existing stock  
   • Mandate net-zero‐energy or passive-house standards for new construction  

3. Boost urban renewables and greenspace  
   • Install rooftop solar and district heating powered by renewables  
   • Plant street trees and create parks to sequester CO₂ and cool neighborhoods
